meta_description: Fairdown Locksmith & Security in Manchester. Emergency call-outs, lock repairs, and security upgrades. Fast response, trusted local service.
hero_eyebrow: 24/7 Emergency Response — Locked Out in Minutes
hero_subhead: Locked out of your home or business in Manchester? We attend within 30 minutes, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs to security upgrades, we handle residential and commercial lock work.

services.title: Emergency Lockout Response
services.desc: Locked out at home or work? We arrive within 30 minutes, seven days a week, and open doors without damage. No call-out charge if you're a registered tenant or homeowner.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Broken locks, seized bolts, and wear-and-tear damage. We replace like-for-like or upgrade to higher-security options, fitted the same day.

services.title: Residential Security Upgrades
services.desc: Anti-snap locks, mortice upgrades, and multi-point systems to meet modern insurance standards. We advise on the right spec for your door type.

services.title: Commercial & Business Locks
services.desc: Master key systems, access control, and fire-safety compliance for offices, shops, and warehouses. Full audit and installation service available.

services.title: UPVC & Composite Door Repairs
services.desc: Handle failure, lock mechanism faults, and frame issues on modern doors. Fast same-day fixes to restore security and smooth operation.

services.title: Safe Installation & Opening
services.desc: Install floor and wall safes for valuables and documents. Emergency opening if you've lost the key — no damage where possible.

about_pullquote: I started this because I was locked out myself at midnight. Never again for my customers.
about_para_1: Fairdown Locksmith was founded 18 years ago in Eccles by a tradesman who'd had enough of waiting for help when he needed it. What began as a one-man emergency service has grown into a trusted network covering all of Greater Manchester. We've completed over 2,000 emergency call-outs and built our reputation on turning up fast, working cleanly, and charging fairly — no surprises on the bill.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we treat every lock job seriously, whether it's a midnight lockout or a £5,000 commercial security upgrade. We're independent, not a franchise, so you speak directly to someone who knows Manchester and cares about doing the job right. Most of our work now comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals.

reviews.text: Locked myself out of the house at 11pm on a Sunday. Called Fairdown and the lad was here in 25 minutes. Opened the door without any damage, friendly bloke, and the price was exactly what he'd quoted on the phone. Brilliant service, will definitely use again.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Our shop lock started playing up after a break-in attempt. Fairdown came out same day, replaced it with a much better system, and checked all our other doors. Professional job, fair pricing, and they explained everything clearly. Can't recommend highly enough.
reviews.author: Patricia M.

reviews.text: Had them install a new mortice lock and upgrade our front door handle. Turned up on time, tidy workers, finished in a couple of hours. New locks are brilliant and the quote was spot on. Will be using them again for the back door.
reviews.author: James W.
